data.description:
VRC Investigations is seeking a qualified Learning Program Designer with LMS experience. This position plays a critical role in the development and delivery of engaging educational content for our employees, clients, and customers in the insurance industry. This position supports the creation, implementation, and continuous improvement of training materials and programs across multiple platforms, including our Learning Management System (LMS) and webinar platform. Working closely with the subject matter experts and key stakeholders, the Learning Program Designer ensures that learning experiences align with the organization's goals and meet the needs of a diverse audience. This is a full-time, non-exempt position, reporting to the VP of SIU Compliance & CE.

  

**The successful candidate will have related experience in the following areas:**

- Instructional design and course development for both in-person and online environments
- Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS), including course creation, uploading  
  content, and system management
- Multimedia content development experience, including video editing and e-learning tools (e.g.,  
  Articulate, Captivate, or iSpring).
- Ability to manage delivery of training through webinar platforms (e.g., Zoom) and coordinate  
  virtual events.
- Project management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities  
  simultaneously.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams  
  and stakeholders.
- Technically proficient with SCORM, xAPI, and other e-learning content standards (preferred)
- Experience in customer service and relationship management with both internal and external  
  customers
- Knowledge of the various states’ insurance CE rules and requirements for CE Providers
- Broad knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, AI tools, LLM’s and other productivity  
  tools

**Core Duties & Responsibilities:**

**1. Course Design and Development:**

- Create and design engaging online learning modules, webinars, and blended learning  
  programs
- Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop course content that aligns  
  with organizational needs and goals
- Ensure all content is accessible, visually appealing, and follows instructional design best  
  practices

**2. LMS and Webinar Platform Management:**

- Manage and maintain the organization's Learning Management System (LMS) by  
  uploading courses, monitoring user activity, and troubleshooting issues
- Coordinate and assist SME deliver live webinars and virtual events, ensuring seamless  
  technical execution and engaging participant experiences
- Monitor course completion rates and generate reports to assess the effectiveness of the  
  training programs

**3. Stakeholder Collaboration and Support:**

- Provide training and technical support to employees, supervisors, and clients on using  
  the LMS and webinar platforms
- Work closely with other departments to ensure consistency and alignment in course  
  offerings across the organization
- Collect and analyze course feedback to continuously improve the learning experience

**4. Content and Process Improvement:**

- Stay current with emerging trends in instructional design and e-learning tools to  
  recommend improvements
- Assist with the formatting and editorial review of course materials to ensure  
  grammatical and stylistic accuracy
- Evaluate new technologies and strategies to enhance the learning experience for both  
  internal and external audiences

**5. Customer Education and CE Programs:**

- Support the development and administration of Continuing Education (CE) programs  
  for licensed professionals
- Maintain required documentation for CE courses and ensure compliance with state  
  regulations
- Coordinate with HR and other department leaders to provide refresher and compliance  
  training programs

**6. Project Management and Reporting:**

- Manage multiple instructional design projects simultaneously, ensuring all deadlines  
  are met with minimal oversight
- Generate reports on training progress and learner performance and present findings to  
  key stakeholders
- Maintain accurate records of attendance, assessments, and certifications to ensure  
  compliance and audit readiness

**Benefits**:  
VRC offers medical, dental, vison, disability benefits, as well as paid vacation, and a 401K/Profit Sharing retirement plan.

**Compensation**:  
VRC employees are paid on a bi-weekly basis at an hourly wage based on commensurate with experience.  
For more information and to apply online, please visit our web site located at www.vrcinvestigations.com

VRC Investigations, part of the Alpine Intel suite of services, is the leading national provider of investigative and insurance fraud solutions in the U.S. Since our founding in 1995, we have worked hard to grow our operation into a team of hundreds of directly employed licensed investigators in the field and many more dedicated staff supporting all areas of the company from offices around the country. But what matters most about us is what we do for you.  Data-driven and focused on delivering results. VRC is the single-source solution for your insurance program’s investigative, SIU and regulatory compliance needs.  Uncovering the truth is essential to protecting your organization and the people who make it great. In an industry overloaded with claims, the right partner can save you valuable time, streamline operations and minimize risk exposure. Partner with the experts. Uncover the facts. Empower yourself with the knowledge and confidence that comes from having the right insurance defense investigation team watching your back.

We are truth seekers.  In everything we do, we choose integrity, strive for excellence, and pursue our passion for uncovering the facts.
